Shenzhen's hardware ecosystem enables robotic-arm prototyping in days rather than months, attributed not just to price but to suppliers' comfort with short development cycles and frequent design changes -- a structural speed/flexibility advantage distinct from (and compounding) the raw cost advantage documented elsewhere in this dataset.
